text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Monday.
- The fifth anniversary of the fall of Vukovar being marked today.
- Microsoft buys Croatian spelling-checker compiled by Croatian experts.
- The 1997 budget: More finances to be allocated for social services and reconstruction, less for the administration.
- Petrol prices going up have sparked a wave of price increases.
- President Tudjman to return from Washington by end of next week.
- The rehabilitation of Splitska banka means the rejuvenation of Dalmatia, says in an interview Frane Mitrovic the Croatian Consul General in Milan. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
